canonical_title: Minimum intensities in any vertical plane of forward and rear position lights.

versions.title_at_revision: Minimum intensities in any vertical plane of forward and rear position lights.
versions.text:
Each position light intensity must equal or exceed the applicable values in the following table.
{|
| Angle above or below the horizontal plane: | Intensity
| 0^{o} | 1.00 I.
| 0^{o} to 5^{o} | 0.90 I.
| 5^{o} to 10^{o} | 0.80 I.
| 10^{o} to 15^{o} | 0.70 I.
| 15^{o} to 20^{o} | 0.50 I.
| 20^{o} to 30^{o} | 0.30 I.
| 30^{o} to 40^{o} | 0.10 I.
| 40^{o} to 90^{o} | 0.05 I.
|}
